reason: A DeepSeek Harness gamification plugin that tracks session activity into persistent achievements, levels, reports, and streaks, then presents them through badge panels and unlock notifications.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中将会话活动转化为跨会话成就、等级、统计报告和连续活跃记录，并通过徽章面板与解锁通知展示。
summaries.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness activity into cross-session achievements, levels, session reports, and streaks presented through badge panels and unlock notifications.

capabilities: Reads official session and workspace events
Persists achievement and session summary data locally
Displays badge panels, reports, share cards, and unlock notifications
Provides read-only state access and an achievement registration SDK
